title: Pair-Trace Absorption Certificates for Regular Induced Subgraphs
authors: Ruy J. G. B. de Queiroz
summary: We study a fixed-core absorption problem for regular induced subgraphs. A set is q-modular if all induced degrees are congruent modulo q. Given a q-modular witness A and a retained core U subset A, we ask when deleting equal-trace q-tuples from A\U can make U into a 2q-modular witness. The main contribution is a finite absorption-or-obstruction certificate. We give an exact quotient formula for the deletion-tail obstruction in complement-orbit coordinates: the correct expression uses oriented differences n_B - n_{U\B}, not sums.
